How to improve the electrochemically active surface area of electrodes in thermocells through the use of Ti3C2Tx hollow microspheres?
Ti3C2Tx hollow microspheres were synthesized using PMMA templates and mixed with SWCNTs to form a composite film electrode with a 1 cm2 geometric area, tested in 0.1 M Fe2+/3+ aqueous electrolyte.
